source_of_truth: Operator-locked product pivot (this plan's D001-D021 and the design conversation). One derived triage model is the single source of truth; the CLI operator brief, the operator-console workbench, and any agent all render the SAME model. The GUI is a dual-mode operator workbench (Observer + Operator) whose actions in v0 are COPY/OPEN/HANDOFF/REFRESH only — it originates no mutation. Browser-originated governed mutation (real approve/apply from the console) is deferred to plan 2026-06-06-002. Acceptance is operator-OUTCOME via named journeys on real producer state, not DOM-render correctness.
completion_test: On real fleet state, one derived triage model (deduped, gate-reconciled, canonical-serialized, with a data_quality envelope) drives every surface identically. dontpanic operator brief --json exposes the buckets with an allow-list vs an escalate-list (= needs_auth + needs_decision), surfaces uncertainty instead of fabricating, and an agent can boot from it to derive a run-plan + escalation list. The safe tier is a command-line engine the human/agent runs in a terminal (auto_safe only, opt-in/dry-run/logged/reversible). The operator workbench shows ALL unique live human items (deduped + gate-reconciled, Uncertain included, non-human buckets collapsed, NOT capped), lets the human decide/inspect and hand off the exact command to a terminal/agent (the console originates no mutation), and makes hidden/handled items inspectable. Separately, the real 313-item inventory collapses to its expected unique-human count. Each proven by a named-journey test, not DOM presence.

user_journeys.name: human-needs-you-triage
user_journeys.description: H1: a human sits down and asks 'does anything need me right now?' The default workbench view shows ALL unique live needs_auth + needs_decision items (deduped + gate-reconciled, Uncertain riding with them, each one sentence) and nothing else; everything agent-runnable/auto-safe/quiet is collapsed behind a single 'handled' count that filters the same queue.
acceptance_signals: The default view shows ALL unique live needs_auth + needs_decision items, deduped and gate-reconciled, non-human buckets collapsed (no hard count cap)
Separately: the real 313-item fleet fixture collapses to its expected unique-human count
Zero raw JSON and one honest status line

user_journeys.name: human-decide-a-gate
user_journeys.description: H3: a gate is waiting; the human opens it and decides from its evidence (audit findings, diff summary, plan acceptance, signoff) in place, without reading source.
acceptance_signals: A live gate's evidence is rendered enough to decide in place
Only LIVE gates appear (closed/abandoned plans reconciled out)

user_journeys.name: human-operator-hands-off
user_journeys.description: H7: the human operates from the console in Operator mode. Each item exposes intent + a COPY/OPEN handoff: approve/request-changes/reject a gate by copying the exact command or opening a terminal; copy a dry-run/--confirm command for safe-tier; copy a command/run-plan for an agent. The human stays in DontPanic to decide and hand off; execution happens in a terminal/agent. The console originates no mutation in v0.
acceptance_signals: Every action is copy/open/handoff; the console originates no mutation
Observer mode hides the intent/handoff controls; Operator mode shows them and is visually unmistakable
The handed-off command is the exact, runnable command

user_journeys.name: human-audit-what-was-handled
user_journeys.description: H2/H6: the human verifies the agent's compression via the activity strip and why-hidden inspector — what the agent/auto ran and changed (with evidence), and WHY each hidden item was suppressed (bucket + reason: deduped / stale-reconciled / info / agent-runnable).
acceptance_signals: The activity strip shows agent/auto actions with evidence refs + the pipeline line
The full inventory is inspectable with each item's bucket + reason
No item is silently hidden; uncertain items are surfaced

user_journeys.name: human-unblock-and-glance
user_journeys.description: H4/H5: when something is stuck the human sees the block, the one move, and the consequence; on a glance the install health is one honest line.
acceptance_signals: A blocked item shows its single unblock move and consequence
Health renders as one trustworthy line, not six stat tiles

user_journeys.name: agent-boot-and-escalate
user_journeys.description: A1/A2: the operator agent boots, reads operator brief --json, and derives a run-plan (agent_runnable + auto_safe, with commands, ordered by deps) plus a precise escalation list (needs_auth + needs_decision). It runs the safe set only (via the command-line safe-tier) and never touches human-gated items.
acceptance_signals: operator brief --json exposes per-item command/deps/evidence + allow-list vs escalate-list
The escalate-list equals needs_auth + needs_decision exactly
The agent runs nothing human-gated

user_journeys.name: agent-terminal-handoff
user_journeys.description: A5: workbench open beside a terminal/Cursor agent. The human hands work off from the console (copy run-plan, open-in-terminal/agent), the agent executes externally, and the result is recorded via a handed-off evidence command and refreshed back into the triage model so the console re-reads reality. v0 'send to agent' is copy/open, not live dispatch.
acceptance_signals: The console can hand a run-plan/command to a terminal or chosen agent (copy/open)
External work is recorded via a handed-off evidence command, not a GUI-originated write
Refresh re-reads the model after the external agent/terminal acted

user_journeys.name: agent-honesty-under-uncertainty
user_journeys.description: A3/A4: the agent reports back truthfully what it ran (feeding the activity log), and when classification is incomplete it narrates the uncertain items + data-quality warnings rather than fabricating a clean bucket.
acceptance_signals: The brief carries a data_quality block (counts, uncertain, staleness) and an embedded honesty contract
Incomplete classification surfaces as uncertain, never fabricated
What the agent ran is recorded with evidence for the human to audit

user_journeys.name: operator-applies-safe-tier
user_journeys.description: Safe-tier application: a command the human (in a terminal) or an agent runs, applying only auto_safe (reversible derived-state) items, dry-run first, logged and reversible, never credentials/approvals/project mutations. Off by default. The console only hands off the command; it does not apply from the browser in v0.
acceptance_signals: Dry-run is the default and mutates nothing
Confirm applies only auto_safe items and writes a reversible evidence record
needs_auth / needs_decision / project-mutating items are refused; the console only hands off the command
